correctness.rationale: Three copies of each letter are forced by each aaa target and realized by three alphabet permutations. Every aba has a witness precisely when b occurs inside the first-to-third a span. The six forbidden two-letter projections are exhaustively characterized among 20 arrangements. An inductive state recurrence exactly enumerates all shortest hosts; its independent q=4 literal census checks all 369600 candidates and returns 80016. The proved recurrence evaluates q=5 to 17825160. No unproved infinite extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: A natural shortest-sequence design space over the canonical four-letter motif alphabet is enumerated exactly, with a proof of minimality, six-forbidden-two-letter-projection structural characterization for arbitrary alphabet size, a reusable exact DP, and a nontrivial five-letter extension. The four-letter 80016 result and contrast to all-pattern covering (13824) quantify design freedom that full-universality algorithms do not report. This is a motivated finite invariant, not an arbitrary truncation or a recomputation of an identified existing table.
